resources.string: Identity, global templates and workspace instructions

This page lists the global system prompts only: identity, the main system prompt, workspace instructions, memory, skills, scheduled tasks and MCP. Per-tool descriptions, voice/vision/title/compaction scenarios and runtime reminders belong to the features that send them and are not edited here. Open one to read or edit its full text; an edit applies the next time the prompt is assembled.
